He places on record the copy of the depositions of both the witnesses, which are marked as 'x' and 'y' for identification and taken on record.
It is the submission of the learned counsel for applicant that the applicant is in custody since 15.05.2024 and has suffered enough detention.

prays for grant of regular bail.
